concept.name: entity
concept.notes: anything having existence (living or nonliving)

concept.name: being
concept.notes: any living entity

concept.name: causal agent
concept.notes: any entity that causes events to happen

concept.name: person
concept.notes: a human being; "there was too much for one person to do"

concept.name: animal
concept.notes: a living organism characterized by voluntary movement

concept.name: plant
concept.notes: a living organism lacking the power of locomotion

concept.name: object
concept.notes: a physical (tangible and visible) entity; "it was full of rackets, balls and other objects"

concept.name: substance
concept.notes: that which has mass and occupies space; "an atom is the smallest indivisible unit of matter"

concept.name: food
concept.notes: any substance that can be metabolized by an organism to give energy and build tissue

concept.name: knowledge
concept.notes: the psychological result of perception and learning and reasoning

concept.name: motivation
concept.notes: the psychological feature that arouses an organism to action; the reason for the action; "we did not understand his motivation"; "he acted with the best of motives"

concept.name: feeling
concept.notes: the psychological feature of experiencing affective and emotional states; "he had a feeling of euphoria"

concept.name: location
concept.notes: a point or extent in space

concept.name: shape
concept.notes: the spatial arrangement of something as distinct from its substance; "geometry is the mathematical science of shape"

concept.name: time
concept.notes: the continuum of experience in which events pass from the future through the present to the past

concept.name: space
concept.notes: the unlimited 3-dimensional expanse in which everything is located; "they tested his ability to locate objects in space"

concept.name: state
concept.notes: the way something is with respect to its main attributes; "the current state of knowledge"; "his state of health"; "in a weak financial state"

concept.name: event
concept.notes: something that happens at a given place and time

concept.name: act
concept.notes: something that people do or cause to happen

concept.name: group
concept.notes: any number of entities (members) considered as a unit

concept.name: possession
concept.notes: anything owned or possessed

concept.name: attribute
concept.notes: an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of an entity

concept.name: relation
concept.notes: an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of two entities or parts together

concept.name: measure
concept.notes: how much there is of something that you can measure = QUANTITY

concept.name: kindness
concept.notes: a kind act

concept.name: accomplishment
concept.notes: the act of accomplishing something

concept.name: deed
concept.notes: a notable achievement: "the book was her finest effort"

concept.name: action
concept.notes: something done (usually as opposed to something said); "there were stories of murders and other unnatural actions"

concept.name: course
concept.notes: a mode of action; "if you persist in that course you will surely fail"

concept.name: contact
concept.notes: close interaction: "they kept in daily contact"; "they claimed that they had been in contact with extraterrestrial beings"

concept.name: going
concept.notes: advancing toward a goal; "persuading him was easy going" or "the proposal faces tough sledding"

concept.name: arrival
concept.notes: accomplishment of an objective

concept.name: arrival
concept.notes: the act of arriving at a certain place; "they awaited her arrival"

concept.name: attainment
concept.notes: arrival at a new stage; "his attainment of puberty was delayed by malnutrition"

concept.name: entrance
concept.notes: the act of entering; "she made a grand entrance"

concept.name: landing
concept.notes: the act of coming down to the earth (or other surface); "the plane made a smoothe landing"; "his landing on his feet was catlike"

concept.name: departure
concept.notes: act of departing

concept.name: vanishing
concept.notes: suddenly disappearing from sight

concept.name: retreat
concept.notes: (military) withdrawal to a more favorable position

concept.name: exit
concept.notes: the act of going out

concept.name: egress
concept.notes: the act of coming (or going) out; becoming apparent

concept.name: completion
concept.notes: the act of becoming or making complete: "her work is still far from completion"

concept.name: realization
concept.notes: something that is realized; "the victory was the realization of a whole year's work"

concept.name: fulfillment
concept.notes: the act of consummating something (a desire or promise etc)

concept.name: attainment
concept.notes: the act of achieving an aim; "the attainment of independence"

concept.name: success
concept.notes: an attainment that is successful; "his success in the marathon was unexpected"; "his new play was a great success"

concept.name: winning
concept.notes: succeeding with great difficulty; "just winning the shore exhausted him"

concept.name: loss
concept.notes: the act of losing; "everyone expected him to win so his loss was a shock"

concept.name: leaning
concept.notes: the act deviating from a vertical position

concept.name: mistake
concept.notes: a wrong action attributable to bad judgment or ignorance or inattention; "the fault was all mine"

concept.name: spill
concept.notes: a sudden drop from an upright position; "he had a nasty spill on the ice"

concept.name: acquisition
concept.notes: the act of contracting or assuming or acquiring possession of something; "the acquisition of wealth"; "the acquisition of one company by another"

concept.name: acquiring
concept.notes: the act of acquiring something; "I envied his talent for acquiring new friends"; "did you hear about his getting a car?"

concept.name: obtainment
concept.notes: the act of obtaining

concept.name: purchase
concept.notes: the acquisition of something for payment; "they closed the purchase with a handshake"

concept.name: trading
concept.notes: buying or selling securities or commodities

concept.name: buying
concept.notes: the act of buying; "buying equipment for the trip took several hours"

concept.name: acceptance
concept.notes: the act of taking something that is offered; "her acceptance of the gift encouraged him"; "he anticipated their acceptance of his offer"

concept.name: inheritance
concept.notes: any acquisition from past generations

concept.name: appropriation
concept.notes: a deliberate act of acquisition

concept.name: confiscation
concept.notes: seizure by the government

concept.name: conquest
concept.notes: the act of conquering

concept.name: restitution
concept.notes: getting something back again; "upon the restitution of the book to its rightful owner the child was given a tongue lashing"

concept.name: reception
concept.notes: the act of receiving

concept.name: disposal
concept.notes: the act or means of getting rid of something

concept.name: giving
concept.notes: disposing of property by voluntary transfer without receiving value in return

concept.name: recovery
concept.notes: the act of regaining or saving something lost (or in danger of becoming lost)

concept.name: rescue
concept.notes: recovery or preservation from loss or danger; "work is the deliverance of mankind" or "a surgeon's job is the saving of lives"

concept.name: expiation
concept.notes: the act of atoning for sin or wrongdoing

concept.name: liberation
concept.notes: the act of liberating someone or something

concept.name: performance
concept.notes: the act of doing something successfully; using knowledge as distinguished from merely possessing it; "experience generally improves performance"

concept.name: service
concept.notes: the performance of duties by a waiter or servant; "that restaurant has excellent service"

concept.name: magic trick
concept.notes: an illusory feat; considered magical by naive observers

concept.name: musical performance
concept.notes: act of performing music

concept.name: playing
concept.notes: the act of playing a musical instrument

concept.name: impulse
concept.notes: the act of applying force suddenly; "the impulse knocked him over"

concept.name: throw
concept.notes: the act of throwing (propelling something through the air with a rapid movement of the arm and wrist); "the catcher made a good throw to second base"

concept.name: press
concept.notes: the act of pressing; "he gave the button a press"; "he used pressure to stop the bleeding"

concept.name: pull
concept.notes: the act of pulling; applying force to move something toward or with you; "the pull up the hill had him breathing harder"; "his strenuous pulling strained his back"

concept.name: drag
concept.notes: the act of dragging (pulling with force); "the drag up the hill exhausted him"

concept.name: lift
concept.notes: the act of raising something; "he responded with a lift of his eyebrow"; "fireman learn several different raises for getting ladders up"

concept.name: expulsion
concept.notes: the act of expelling or projecting or ejecting

concept.name: belch
concept.notes: a reflex that expels wind noisily from the stomach through the mouth

concept.name: blink
concept.notes: a reflex that closes and opens the eyes rapidly

concept.name: spit
concept.notes: the act of spitting (forcefully expelling saliva)

concept.name: vomit
concept.notes: the act of ejecting the contents of the stomach through the mouth

concept.name: cough
concept.notes: the act of exhaling air suddenly with a noise

concept.name: jump
concept.notes: the act of jumping; propelling yourself off the ground; "he advanced in a series of jumps"; "the jumping was unexpected"

concept.name: leap
concept.notes: a light springing movement upwards or forwards

concept.name: sending
concept.notes: causing something to go; "the cost of sending their children to college"

concept.name: shooting
concept.notes: the act of firing a projectile; "his shooting was slow but accurate"

concept.name: contact
concept.notes: the act of touching physically; "her fingers came in contact with the light switch"

concept.name: rub
concept.notes: the act of rubbing or wiping; "he gave the hood a quick rub"

concept.name: hit
concept.notes: a act of hitting one thing with another; "repeated hitting raised a large bruise"; "after three misses she finally got a hit"

concept.name: collision
concept.notes: the act of colliding with something

concept.name: kick
concept.notes: the act of delivering a blow with the foot; "he gave the ball a powerful kick"

concept.name: kiss
concept.notes: a caress with the lips

concept.name: catch
concept.notes: the act of catching an object with the hands; "Mays made the catch with his back to the plate"

concept.name: joining
concept.notes: the act of bringing two things into contact
